name: ARCADE-Checkout-Human
description: Human checkout demonstrations at a self-checkout counter: 3-D body and hand pose, product 6-DoF trajectories, grasp/release events, hand-object holding labels and object segmentation masks.

coordinate_frame.name: counter
coordinate_frame.x_axis: forward: the direction the shopper faces, across the counter
coordinate_frame.z_axis: up, normal of the counter top
coordinate_frame.origin: on the counter top (z = 0), at the checkout-lane centroid
coordinate_frame.pose_vector: [x, y, z, qx, qy, qz, qw]

wrist_frame.y_axis: right hand: pinky_mcp -> index_mcp; left hand: index_mcp -> pinky_mcp; orthogonalised against x
wrist_frame.z_axis: x cross y: the back-of-hand normal (the palm faces -z) for both hands

object_frame.origin: centre of the product mesh bounding box
object_frame.axes: product axes; a cylinder's axis and a box's 'h' edge are the local z axis
object_frame.mesh: objects/<product>/<product>_p<perm>.obj is already expressed in this frame, so world_vertex = R(q) @ mesh_vertex + p

not_included.rgb: RGB video is not part of this release. For recordings whose participants consented to sharing, it can be provided on request, after consultation and de-identification
not_included.camera_calibration: camera intrinsics and extrinsics are not released
not_included.scan_events: none: the point-of-sale scanner was not linked during this capture
not_included.product_physics: mass and friction were not measured

selection: all segmented episodes of the session. check_passed marks the episodes that pass the automatic quality check; check_failed lists the rules an episode fails (check_rules)

check_rules.product_below_counter: the product is below the counter top
check_rules.product_floating: a resting product is not on the counter, or a carried product is away from the carrying hand
check_rules.resting_product_moves: a resting product moves, tilts, stands upside down or is not on a stable face
check_rules.product_leaves_hand: the carried product leaves the palm of the carrying hand
check_rules.product_slips_in_hand: the carried product jumps in the hand from one frame to the next
check_rules.hand_product_gap: a gap between hand and product at a grasp or a release
check_rules.hand_in_product: the hand is inside the product while carrying it
check_rules.product_pose_missing: the product pose is unknown in too many frames
check_rules.product_vs_masks: the posed product disagrees with its camera masks over the episode or over a run of frames
check_rules.held_product_vs_masks: while carried well above the counter, the posed product disagrees with its camera masks
check_rules.held_product_axis: while carried well above the counter, the long axis of the posed product disagrees with its masks

counter.note: footprint of the counter top in the counter frame (m): a box around every resting product position of the session

files.meta/episodes.jsonl: one JSON object per episode (index of data/human_motion.hdf5)
files.meta/products.json: product catalogue: shape, dimensions, mesh variants
files.data/human_motion.hdf5: all per-frame data, one group per episode
files.objects/: product meshes (OBJ + MTL + texture), one variant per axis permutation
files.segmentation/: per episode: instances.json and masks.zip, binary masks of the tracked objects (optional)
